Both metrics moved favorably and by material amounts. A 73% increase in cash combined with a $2.2B debt reduction represents material strengthening of the balance sheet position across both liquidity and leverage dimensions.

The claim does not specify which metrics define "materially stronger," but cash and debt are universally recognized as fundamental indicators of balance sheet health. The magnitude of improvement in both metrics supports the characterization as "materially stronger."
